title: Breakfast Enchiladas for the Crew
subtitle: Rolled tortillas stuffed with eggs and chorizo under green chili sauce.
description: Corn tortillas rolled with scrambled eggs and sausage, smothered in enchilada sauce and cheese, baked until bubbling. Cut squares from a casserole dish — pure hall comfort.

ingredients.name: Sour Cream
ingredients.notes: whisked into half the sauce for creaminess

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 375°F. Grease a deep 9x13 pan or two smaller hotel pans. Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or wrapped in foil so they roll without tearing.

steps.title: Cook the filling
steps.instruction: Brown chorizo in a large skillet, drain fat, then add soft-scrambled eggs and half the Jack cheese. Mix gently—the eggs should stay fluffy, not mashed.

steps.title: Roll the enchiladas
steps.instruction: Spread a thin layer of sauce in the pan. Fill each tortilla with a generous scoop of filling, roll tight, and place seam-side down in a snug single layer.

steps.title: Sauce and cheese
steps.instruction: Pour remaining sauce evenly over the rolls. Top with remaining Jack and cotija. Cover with foil for the first half of baking to keep tortillas soft.

steps.title: Bake and rest
steps.instruction: Bake covered 20 minutes, uncover, and bake 10 more until sauce bubbles at the edges. Rest 10 minutes before cutting into portions so slices hold on the plate.

stationWorkflow: Set up a rolling station with warm tortillas, filling bowl, and sauced pan ready before scrambling eggs.
One cook rolls while another manages sauce and oven timing—don't let rolled enchiladas sit dry on the counter.
Garnish with cilantro and lime at the line; hold extra sauce warm for second passes.
cleanupNotes: Soak the chorizo skillet immediately with hot water and a drop of dish soap to cut grease before it sets.
Scrape baked-on cheese from the 9x13 while still warm using a plastic scraper, not a metal blade on glass.
leftovers: Portion enchiladas into containers with extra sauce on top; reheat covered at 325°F until steaming in the center.
Chop leftovers into a breakfast burrito filling with scrambled eggs and hot sauce for handheld service.
